title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-agent-safe-gh-calls: carry parked/agent/safe-gh-calls onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/agent/safe-gh-calls` at 7ca7bc7454 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: scripts/apply_github_settings.sh, scripts/lane.sh, scripts/lib-safe.sh, scripts/metrics.sh, scripts/retriage.sh, scripts/sla.sh)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/agent/safe-gh-calls
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/agent/safe-gh-calls

**Evidence:** Superseded in substance: scripts/lib-safe.sh (timeout, counted failures, safe_exit) is on main and sourced by lane.sh, metrics.sh, retriage.sh, sla.sh, triage.sh and others. The scripts/check_ultrastable.sh gate was not ported: unstick_prs.sh and mirror_then_delete.sh would need rewrites that turn expected gh failures red.
